data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
This includes a range of reports providing information on the volume and cost of prescribing for selected organisations down to prescriber level.

### Volume and cost summary
Provides high level figures on the volume and cost of prescribing broken down for a range of areas including ‘Generic v Proprietary Prescribing’ and ‘EPS v Paper Prescriptions'.

### Comparator analysis
Provides the ability to define a comparator to review prescribing for Sub ICB Locations (SICBLs). The numerator and denominator for the comparator can be defined using selections from any BNF level.

### Trend analysis
Provides a trend analysis for selected organisations and selected BNF levels for volume & cost.
